thread:
Nina Park: Atlas asked to accelerate Marketplace listing. Main security asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and HSM-backed KMS (PKCS#11). Need quick alignment on what goes live vs beta.
Owen Reed: OK. We can publish listing with SAML + SCIM docs. HSM integration needs attestation work; propose "HSM private beta" copy.
Sophie Laurent: agree. For SCIM we need attribute map and example provisioning flow. For SAML include metadata blob and ACS URL.
Atlas Partner Bot: Atlas uploaded SAML metadata: https://atlas.partners/saml/meta.xml (48h)
Owen Reed: minimal SAML snippet for listing:
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sso.atlas.example">
  <SingleSignOnService Location="https://api.redwood.example/saml/acs"/>
</EntityDescriptor>
SCIM map example: userName->email, name.givenName->first_name, name.familyName->last_name, active->is_active
Nina Park: rotation webhook details? Atlas needs endpoint to notify us when they rotate envelope keys.
Owen Reed: webhook: https://api.redwood.example/kms/atlas-rotate, HMAC signature required. Payload includes key_id, rotated_at, attestation_url.
Sophie Laurent: security wants attestation URL to return signed evidence (JWS) and mutual TLS. Add to checklist.
Nina Park: timeline: partner wants listing by 5/12, joint demo week of 5/12, HSM GA later. Can we commit?
Owen Reed: yes to listing + SAML/SCIM + demo script by 5/12. HSM attestation in private beta after that.
Nina Park: action items: Owen -> runbook + demo + webhook example; Sophie -> security checklist + attestation requirements; Nina -> partner comms and marketplace copy.
Atlas Partner Bot: Request: logo lock 5/10, copy sign-off 5/11.
Nina Park: added. scheduling quick sync tomorrow 9am PT.
